summary: Short, steep kerb on a bend beside a main road, no verge.
reasons: House 15 m, tree-lined kerb, no verge

drivers.seclusion: Dwelling 15 m away, three more within 23 to 36 m; busy road immediately north.
drivers.access_and_room: Only 10 m of kerb curving into a junction with an arterial; trees to the kerb and no verge or pull-off.
drivers.traffic: Four-lane arterial next to the section, with slip lane turning traffic.
drivers.convention: One car parked on the street just south; no parking convention on this kerb.

sun_shade: Tree canopy covers the section from the west and north.
